items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146 (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This update resolves a critical vulnerability (StyleSmuggler) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of CVE-2026-75650 being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-138
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover (APSB26-92)
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, leading to account takeover and access to private customer data. It has been added to the CISA KEV catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.
